name: Indian Chief (2014-on)
engine: 1811 cc air/oil-cooled Thunder Stroke 111 V-twin (116 from 2020), fuel injected, belt drive
intro: The modern Chief family. The Thunder Stroke 111 bikes had several recalls, including a fuel rail recall on 2014-2017 bikes.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2014-2016 Thunder Stroke bikes are in recall 16V446 (misfire can overheat the exhaust). 2014-2017 bikes are in recall 16V877 (fuel rail can leak). 2014 Chiefs are in recall 19V339 (headlight). 2014-2019 bikes are in recall 19V776 (gear position switch). Some 2014 Chiefs are also in recall 22V635 (headlight software).
A-002.reason: A fuel leak is a fire risk. Every fix is free.

recalls.what: An ignition misfire can overheat the exhaust and create a fire risk.
